messages:
liz: FYI - OrbitEdge (hardware + SI integrator) wants a marketplace listing + joint press the week of May 9. They shared a SOC excerpt, their internal pentest summary, and a 12-question security form. We need to triage for listing requirements ASAP.

rachel: thanks. main asks: confirm minimum artifacts for our listing intake, and whether HW attestation (firmware signing) is required for the marketplace.

nate: skimmed files. SOC excerpt references key mgmt but no exported key policy. pen summary is vendor-scoped with no CVE timeline. questionnaire has gaps on incident response.

liz: ok. luis, can you take firmware signing/firmware attestation ask? emily, can you own incident response evidence + IR playbook excerpt?

luis: yes. for HW we need a firmware signing statement: who signs, signing key custody, and verification method used by devices. i'll request signed manifest or pgp key fingerprint.

emily: i'll ask for a redacted IR runbook, an example postmortem, and SLA for breach notifications. target: deliver request list by EOD tomorrow.

sec-bot: auto-scan: questionnaire flags: MFA on admin accounts not documented, telemetry retention limit unspecified. Details: https://redwood-sec/reports/1769998888-qna

nate: MFA on admin is a blocker for marketplace listing. we need explicit admin MFA and an attest or timeline.

liz: add these items to the intake doc. i'm thinking minimal required uploads: 1) SOC excerpt with control mapping to our checklist, 2) firmware signing attestation (if HW in path), 3) KMS/key custody statement or policy export, 4) pen-test summary with scope + remediation dates OR agreement to scoped re-test, 5) IR artifacts + notification contact, 6) telemetry/log retention evidence.

rachel: good. also ask for a short dataflow diagram showing where customer data touches OrbitEdge systems vs SI-managed customers. that's critical for post-sales compliance.

emily: redaction note - partner must scrub customer names and live IPs from screenshots. Product-security will do final review before publish.

luis: for firmware attestation template i'll paste a tiny spec they can fill: signing algorithm, signer identity, key storage (HSM/cloud KMS/local), verification process, and sample signature header.

ops-bot: presign-helper: Presign links can be created with tag: marketplace=orbitedge, expiry default 72h. Requestor: liz.

liz: timeline proposal: notify partner today, partner uploads within 6 business days, internal review 2 business days, redaction/ops check 1 business day, final go/no-go signoff. launch comms only after signoff.

nate: contingency for pen test gaps: accept vendor report only if it enumerates OS/kernel/firmware CVEs and provides ETA for remediation. otherwise contract a 4-hour scoped scan with our assessment team.

rachel: also clarifying audience: is this a public marketplace tile or private marketplace (partner-managed)? affects how much we require publicly redacted evidence vs intake-only. OrbitEdge wants public tile.

liz: public tile = stricter. require explicit public-safe artifacts and final redaction approval.

emily: I'll coordinate with product-security for redaction checklist. pls CC me on any uploads that contain logs.

sec-bot: scheduled reminder: compliance-check-in in #partnerships at 1769999400

luis: i posted the firmware attestation template in shared drive: https://docs.redwood/hw-attest/templates/orbitedge

liz: I've drafted the intake email to OrbitEdge (snip): "Please upload the items to the Redwood intake bucket using the presigned links we'll provide. Include checksums and mark files with tag: marketplace=orbitedge. Redact PII; we will request additional details if items are incomplete."

rachel: can infra extend presign expiration to 7 days for partners that need it? some partners are behind procurement.

ops-bot: presign-config: extension to 7 days possible once liz requests it.

nate: last point - please capture contact for their SOC owner and SRE lead in the intake so we can do live Q&A if needed.

liz: done. i'll send the intake + presign links in this thread when ops provides them. thanks team. :party_parrot:
